text:
Kalpana - thank you!

Alyssa - great meeting you via email! Here are my comments and requested
updates:

1) The Misc section terms that supersede prior order forms is in conflict
with this statement "This Order Form is governed by the existing Terms and
Conditions between Encord and Skydio executed on January 24th, 2025." - can
you please address?
2) We want the US-based hours to roll cumulatively quarter-over-quarter
(e.g., from Q1 to Q2 and even into Q3) so please add a clarification about
this point as well
3) The Jan 2025 order form had a 98% quality standard that needs to be
added to this OF - updated language is below:

   - Encord shall make commercially reasonable efforts to ensure that the
   annotation teams meet the agreed-upon quality standards, which shall
   include a minimum accuracy level of 98% to be mutually agreed upon by the
   parties in writing.

4) We need to add the following for our data/security provisions:

   - Add this definition: "US-Based Labeling Services means labeling
   performed only by individuals physically located in the US at the time of
   access.”
   - Add this access restriction: "Client data associated with US-Based
   Labeling Services may not be accessed, viewed, or processed from outside
   the United States (including by Encord personnel and subcontractors)
   without Client’s prior written consent. No subcontractor may access Client
   data for US-Based Labeling Services unless (i) US-located, (ii) bound to
   confidentiality/data-protection terms at least as protective, and (iii)
   listed/approved in writing by Client.”
   - Add this data storage restriction: "Client data and deliverables will
   be stored and processed in US data centers only.”
   - Add this security restriction: "Encord shall provide the services with
   the following security protocols: a) incident notice within 48–72 hours, b)
   annual SOC2 report access under MNDA, and c) a minimum level of industry
   standard security controls."

Best regard

subject: Re: Encord - Interest
text:
Hi Hugo,

My interest in Encord stems from its strong alignment with my work in AI
systems for high-risk governance environments and production workflows. I
build and advise on AI solutions where data quality, traceability,
auditability, and human-in-the-loop oversight are critical, especially in
regulated, government-adjacent, and safety-critical contexts. Encord's
focus on dataset curation, annotation, model evaluation, and governance
directly addresses the challenges I face in creating trustworthy AI and
compliance-ready pipelines.

Our team is a small, cross-functional group of 2-5 senior members covering
AI/ML engineering, data automation, and governance. We operate leanly and
scale contributors as projects progress.

Currently, our projects are in the early-to-mid build stage, transitioning
from proof-of-concept to structured pilots. We are focused on validating
data pipelines and governance controls over the next 3-6 months, with a
goal to scale operations within 6-12 months.

Warm regards,
